name: Japan Net-Net (cyclical deep value)
thesis: A basket of eight TSE Standard/Prime small-caps trading at low price-to-book with large cash-and-securities balances relative to market cap — classic Japanese deep value across steel, auto-body/seats, engineering, electrical, coatings, scrap and trading. The pitched hook is that recent drawdowns are benign round-trips of momentum spikes rather than impairment, supported by upward FY26 guidance revisions at some names. On our own tape check that hook holds cleanly for only a minority of the basket; the sleeve is a diversified low-multiple carry-and-mean-reversion play whose realized edge depends on capital-return governance pressure and cyclical recovery, not on any single valve/LNG story. Held unhedged in yen; USD total return is the measuring stick.
author: pitch-bot
